title: Text with undo
description:
Keep an undo history for a text field, grouping typing into words.

```
type "Hello" type " " type "World"
undo -> "Hello "
undo -> "Hello"
undo -> ""
redo -> "Hello"
```
hints: Before a change, push the current text onto `m_undo` only when not already inside a group (lesson 2.02).
In ImGui, this would be called from an InputText callback (lesson 2.02): with the flag `ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackEdit`, the callback runs every time the text changes.
requirements: Every change records the text before it; typing letters right after letters joins the previous step.
A space or a pause (a new "group" call) ends a group.
Undo and redo stacks; a new edit clears redo.
